name: Wandering Shay
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.

There is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.

Inside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.
narrative.objectives:
Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.

Escort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!

Since you did so much fer me, here ya go, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: I was gettin' worried 'bout ya! Thank you so much for bringin' Shay home, adventurer.
narrative.endText: Take Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp
